name: remote-stop-without-a-reply-clears-the-turn
description: A remote turn ends with a Stop that carries no reply text. The working state clears, nothing is logged, and a later expiry has nothing left to clear.
reason: Stop is the normal end of a turn whether or not it carries text; an empty Stop must still end the turn, or the light waits the full fifteen minutes for the expiry.
source: DESIGN.md v1.10 'stop and sessionEnd remove their session's entry'; AppState.handleRemoteEvent(.stop)

script.reason: The turn ends with only whitespace as its reply.
The expiry check the turn armed runs, and finds nothing to do.
